This error leads to incorrect area calculations, which is reflected in the metamorphic relations (MRs) failing, as the area computed for transformed inputs does not match the expected relation.

uncertainty: The code may have other issues, but the most clear and supported defect is the incorrect semi-perimeter calculation in line 29. This is the primary source of the observed failures in the MRs.
